analysis: Docs-only change in docs/reference/configuration.md: the sole changed head line, 414 per range map (complete), adds documentation for DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED, a Gated DeltaNet prefill kernel selector for qwen3_5 models. The default probe keeps a faster kernel only where it reproduces the stock kernel bit for bit. Forced modes (packed/rows) skip that check, are documented as A/B-only, are read once per process and are not forwarded to LaunchAgents. Under TB-003, an operator setting a forced kernel could alter numerical outputs. That is within the existing T-007/T-056 operator-controlled computation risk (ADV-001 can already modify the runtime and outputs); attestation does not claim correct computation. No change to encryption, attestation, authorization, prefix-cache (T-041), or billing controls. The supplied units are unchanged surrounding text (base 519-686, head 1-353): GLM, cache, endpoint-resumption and worker sections. They were reviewed for context, and no regression was identified. The implementation in libs/mlx-swift-lm GatedDelta.swift is not supplied, so the documented probe/fallback and passthrough-exclusion behavior is unverified. The documented launchd non-forwarding is not proof of the LaunchAgent.passthroughEnvKeys contents.
